amenities.detail: Walkable access to The Square at Lotis Wellington (Foxtail Coffee Co., Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant, Kura Sushi, boutiques, wellness destinations)
Resort-style/exclusive clubhouse (per Lennar community page; wellingtonhometeam.com describes it as resort-style with pool). Retrieved 2026-10-12T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.9.

Walking trails (Lennar); wellingtonhometeam.com adds sidewalks and bike trails throughout the community. Retrieved 2026-10-12T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.9.
Parks and children's playground. Retrieved 2026-10-12T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.7.
Gated single-family home and townhome community (gate/security staffing details not specified). Retrieved 2026-10-12T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.7.

The Pavilions: ~60,000 sq ft of medical and professional offices plus rental residences. Retrieved 2026-10-12T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.7.
